purpose: Define the evidence package required before selecting or executing an alternative containment backend on a different host.

identity: exact OS product name, edition ID, version, build and architecture
exact hardware virtualization and SLAT state
exact CPU, RAM and free-disk resource envelope
exact administrator and Hyper-V Administrators membership declaration
features: vmms, vmcompute and hns service identity and state
New-VM, Get-VM, hcsdiag and selected runtime identities
policy: documented process-tree security boundary and closure
explicit read-only and read-write filesystem grants with deny outside scope
outbound default-deny with bounded-host no-bypass mechanism
complete list of host DACL, firewall, registry, feature, restart and elevation mutations
packet_compatibility: exact literal E:\ namespace or an explicitly authorized packet rewrite
all 37 literal argv preserved unless a new packet is independently audited
per-command scratch and runner-control journal isolation
retry count zero and immutable-attempt semantics
artifacts_and_licenses: guest or container image source, immutable digest, version compatibility and license
runtime or HCS client source, immutable identity and support status
network relay or proxy source, immutable identity and policy proof

fail_closed_conditions: Home/Core edition where official support requires Pro or Enterprise
ambient DACL or firewall mutation not explicitly authorized
outbound allow-all or unproven no-bypass behavior
packet rewrite without a new independent compatibility audit
required_decision_before_preflight: The scholar must identify the changed host and authorize a fresh read-only evidence collection. Backend installation, feature enablement, restart and execution require later separate authorization.
